why: सवित्रे is the dative of सवितृ, fitting 'lead the sacrifice to Savitr'.
नमसे हिता is the dative 'set for homage'; the svara digit 3 in दिवो३ऽभि is accent notation.
अवराँ is the accusative plural with anunasika before a vowel, parallel to इमाँ.
अवसो is the genitive of अवस् governed by विद्याम.
अवतु is the imperative 'may Aditi help', matching जिन्वतु and दधातु of the previous line.
अपस् कः is 'did the work', a regular sandhi of अपः कः.
प्रथमे is the dual agreeing with द्यावा क्षामा.
प्रथमाँ अनु द्यून् is the accusative plural with anunasika before a vowel.
अर्यम्णो is the genitive of अर्यमन् qualifying दुर्याँ.
अपरं चन 'nor in future' is a normal phrase and the metre is complete.
रायोत is the sandhi of रायः + उत.
दिवस्त्वं is the sandhi of दिवः + त्वं.
मदासः is the nominative plural subject of गमन्तु.
विप्रान् is the accusative plural object of धेहि.
सखायौ is the dual agreeing with देवौ and इन्द्राग्नी.
मदानां is the genitive plural after पीत्वा अस्य.
मनसाग्निं is the sandhi of मनसा + अग्निं.
देवीरा is देवीः + आ before तस्थौ.
देवीर्य is देवीः + यः, a regular sandhi.
पवन्ते is the middle 3rd plural with the subject क्षितयः.
दशस्या is a Vedic infinitive-like dative 'to serve', with मनुषे.
पवसे is the 2nd singular middle parallel to मृशसे.

suggest: हि॒र॒ण्ययी॑ अ॒रणी॒ यं नि॒र्मन्थ॑तो अ॒श्विना॑ । तं ते॒ गर्भं॑ हवामहे दश॒मे मा॒सि सूत॑वे ॥
why: तं त॒त गर्भं is no word and makes the pada 9 syllables; ते (your embryo, as in गर्भं ते of the previous verse) gives sense and 8 syllables; दशमे itself is fine.
पृथिव्यास् त्री is the edition's way of writing the sandhi of पृथिव्याः before त्.
वसून् is the accusative plural (the Vasus) in a list of gods invoked.

why: The svarita after udatta वी must fall on रा, not on the unaccented vocative ऽग्ने; the mark slipped across the inserted space before the avagraha.
